    if 'QAP_TIME_LIMIT_S' in os.environ:

    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    n = data['n']

    B = np.array(data['B'], dtype=np.int64)

    # initial permutation: identity
    perm = np.arange(n)
    best_perm = perm.copy()
    best_cost = compute_cost(perm, A, B)

    # Simulated annealing parameters
    max_iter = 100000
    init_temp = 1e4
    final_temp = 1e-2
    alpha = 0.99995

    t = 0
    while time.time() - start_time < budget * 0.95 and t < max_iter:
        # temperature schedule
        T = init_temp * (final_temp / init_temp) ** (t / max_iter)
        # propose 2-opt move
        i, j = np.random.choice(n, 2, replace=False)
        new_perm = perm.copy()
        new_perm[i], new_perm[j] = new_perm[j], new_perm[i]
        new_cost = compute_cost(new_perm, A, B)

                best_cost = new_cost
        t += 1

    # cost = sum_i,j A[i,j] * B[p[i], p[j]]
    return np.sum(A * B[p][:, p])
